negative_reviews.author: Yvis FU
negative_reviews.text:
Not sure how this place has an overall rating of 4.6.

There were flies flying around the restaurant, and the bar seating was really uncomfortable. The reservation management was poor - they left many tables empty while people were waiting, for “reservations”, which weren’t really the case as no one literally showed up.

The food wasn’t particularly original or memorable. Overall, I’d recommend trying somewhere else if you have the option.

negative_reviews.author: Ralph Yeung
negative_reviews.text:
Pros: good tonkotsu broth, great cha siu.
Cons: Service charge added to your bill automatically. Egg was embarrassingly bad.

Worth a try, but definitely better spots available in town.
